g.royal-dama-3d.tag: 3D checkers with sophisticated boards and fast matches.
g.royal-dama-3d.desc: Royal Dama 3D brings the classic checkers game to a three-dimensional board, with realistic pieces, cinematic lighting and an isometric camera. Challenge the computer or a friend and master the strategy of every move.
g.royal-dama-3d.f2: Fast matches against the computer or in pairs
g.badot-strike.tag: Action and shooting in futuristic sci-fi arenas.
g.badot-strike.desc: Bhadott Strike is an action game set in sci-fi arenas. Characters, weapons and settings are original, designed for intense, fast-paced matches.
g.badot-strike.f1: Futuristic arenas with a neon look
g.badot-strike.f2: Fast matches for up to 8 players (concept)
g.blockverse-adventures.tag: Explore, build and create adventures in a world of blocks.
g.blockverse-adventures.desc: BlockVerse Adventures is an exploration and building sandbox in a block world with its own visual identity. Gather resources, assemble structures and discover landscapes that change with every journey.
g.planetario-bhadock.tag: Explore the Solar System in an interactive, educational way.
g.planetario-bhadock.desc: Planetário Bhadock is an interactive space exploration experience: Sun, planets, orbits and stars in motion, with educational information about each celestial body. The motion is illustrative, not a precise scientific simulation.
g.planetario-bhadock.f1: Animated Solar System with speed control
g.planetario-bhadock.f2: Zoom, planet selection and educational fact sheets
g.planetario-bhadock.f3: Runs right in the browser, no plugins
g.magic-valmes.tag: Fantasy, castles and enchanted forests in an adventure RPG.
g.magic-valmes.desc: Magic Valmes is a fantasy adventure RPG set in original worlds, with towering castles, enchanted forests and realms to discover. Shape your journey and unravel the mysteries of each realm.
g.magic-valmes.f3: Narrative adventure for one or two players (concept)
g.eduquest.tag: Educational mini-games to learn in a fun way.
g.eduquest.desc: EduQuest brings together educational mini-games in five areas: Math, Science, Geography, Logical reasoning and General knowledge. Each challenge turns learning into fun.

pl.title: Planetário Bhadock — Explore the Universe
pl.illustrative: Illustrative motion — not a precise scientific simulation
pl.canvasAlt: Interactive 3D Solar System. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom, arrow keys change body, space pauses.
pl.hint: Drag to move, scroll or pinch to zoom, tap a body to see information.
pl.sun.f1: Holds about 99.8% of the Solar System's mass.
pl.sun.f2: Its light takes about 8 minutes to reach Earth.
pl.sun.f3: It is a yellow dwarf star about 4.6 billion years old.
pl.mercury.f1: It is the smallest planet in the Solar System.
pl.mercury.f2: It has huge temperature swings between day and night.
pl.mercury.f3: It circles the Sun in just 88 Earth days.
pl.venus.f1: It is the hottest planet, due to an intense greenhouse effect.
pl.venus.f2: It spins in the opposite direction to most planets.
pl.venus.f3: A day on Venus lasts longer than a Venusian year.
pl.earth.f1: It is the only place known to harbor life.
pl.earth.f2: About 71% of the surface is covered by water.
pl.earth.f3: The Moon influences the ocean tides.
pl.mars.f1: It is called the red planet because of iron oxide on its surface.
pl.mars.f2: It is home to Olympus Mons, the largest known volcano in the Solar System.
pl.mars.f3: It has two small moons: Phobos and Deimos.
pl.jupiter.f1: It is the largest planet in the Solar System.
pl.jupiter.f2: The Great Red Spot is a giant storm.
pl.jupiter.f3: It is a gas giant with no solid surface.
pl.saturn.f1: Its rings are made mostly of ice and rock.
pl.saturn.f2: It is so low in density that, on average, it would float on water.
pl.saturn.f3: It has more than 140 known moons, including Titan.
pl.uranus.f1: It spins almost “on its side”, tilted about 98°.
pl.uranus.f2: It is an ice giant with an atmosphere of hydrogen, helium and methane.
pl.uranus.f3: It was the first planet discovered with a telescope, in 1781.
pl.neptune.f1: It is the planet farthest from the Sun.
pl.neptune.f2: It has some of the fastest winds in the Solar System.
pl.neptune.f3: Its existence was predicted by calculations before it was observed.
